name: CoA Custom races: the added races may take the quests of their faction
contract: The CoA Custom races package widens quest_template.AllowableRaces with the bits of the added races; Horde quests carry 1541213106 instead of 690.
rev_20261012_12 ORs in only the added races' bits (9 and 12-32), so a Skeleton (26, Horde) may take Rude Awakening (363, Deathknell, Horde 690 before) while an Alliance High Elf (14) still may not.
Player::CanTakeQuest without messages is observed (quest_takeable); the client's quest markers are not rendered.
